patterns.note: Feature sections consistently pair a large, bold heading with a prominent 3D illustration or app screenshot, followed by a concise description and often a call to action, creating a clear visual hierarchy for each product benefit.

The site uses a vibrant, almost emerald green as a primary accent and background color, contrasting sharply with clean white and light grey sections, and punctuated by bright yellow/orange elements in illustrations and occasional text highlights.

Headings are set in a large, bold, and slightly condensed sans-serif, while body text uses a highly readable, modern sans-serif. Small, uppercase labels are used for feature descriptions and sub-headings, creating a clear typographic hierarchy.
The footer features a distinctive, full-width row of diverse, playful 3D dog illustrations, serving as a memorable visual anchor and reinforcing the brand's pet-centric identity.
The primary navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport as the user scrolls down the page, providing persistent access to site navigation and key calls to action.

technique_notes: The site integrates high-quality, playful 3D illustrations of pets and pet-related objects directly into the content, using them as visual anchors for feature sections and decorative elements to enhance brand personality.
Section backgrounds alternate between clean white and a vibrant green, creating visual separation and guiding the user's eye down the page without complex transitions.

The main navigation is implemented as a sticky header, maintaining its position at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll. No scroll-triggered content reveals, parallax effects, or complex animations are observed; the page content scrolls linearly.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold headings (~3-4x body) with clear, readable body text and small, uppercase labels for feature descriptions.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons, input fields, and app screenshots, maintaining a clean yet approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced density overall, with airy spacing in the hero and between major sections, and a more compact arrangement within feature grids.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its consistent and extensive use of high-quality, playful 3D illustrations of pets and pet-related items. These illustrations are not just decorative but are integral to explaining features and establishing a friendly, approachable brand identity, making the complex software feel accessible and fun.
